description: Ground truth dataset for SQL correctness evaluation. Use {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{reference_date}} as placeholders — they are replaced at evaluation time.

items.question: Quel est le score de sommeil de {{first_name}} cette semaine ?
items.expected_sql: SELECT ad.date_of_day, ad.sleep_score FROM base_athleteday ad JOIN base_athlete a ON ad.athlete_id = a.id WHERE TRIM(a.first_name) = '{{first_name}}' AND TRIM(a.last_name) = '{{last_name}}' AND ad.date_of_day BETWEEN DATE_SUB('{{reference_date}}', INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND '{{reference_date}}' ORDER BY ad.date_of_day DESC

items.question: Combien d'heures a dormi {{first_name}} la nuit dernière ?
items.expected_sql: SELECT ad.date_of_day, ROUND(s.total_in_bed_time_milli / 3600000, 1) AS hours_in_bed, s.quality_rating, s.sleep_efficiency_percentage FROM sleep_sleep s JOIN base_athleteday ad ON s.athlete_day_id = ad.id JOIN base_athlete a ON ad.athlete_id = a.id WHERE TRIM(a.first_name) = '{{first_name}}' AND TRIM(a.last_name) = '{{last_name}}' AND ad.date_of_day = '{{reference_date}}'

items.expected_sql: SELECT ad.date_of_day, ROUND(s.total_in_bed_time_milli / 3600000, 1) AS hours_in_bed, s.sleep_efficiency_percentage, s.quality_rating FROM sleep_sleep s JOIN base_athleteday ad ON s.athlete_day_id = ad.id JOIN base_athlete a ON ad.athlete_id = a.id WHERE TRIM(a.first_name) = '{{first_name}}' AND TRIM(a.last_name) = '{{last_name}}' AND ad.date_of_day >= DATE_SUB('{{reference_date}}', INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY ad.date_of_day ASC
